Switzerland was once a very poor country, run by farmers mostly. 
Three of my grandfather‘s siblings *emigrated* : Two brothers to North America (Boston) & one brother to South America (Argentina). 
The one in Argentina always wanted him to come as well. 
I still keep all these old & very precious handwritten letters from Argentina & from the States, dated around 1900 !!!! 
We are used to forget many things, well, we forget to mention them 🤷‍♀️

comments.text: As a swiss guy I cannot deny that my country makes me proud. I think the main reason for this suspectes comes from education. We can the the counter example with the USA where the good education isn’t affordable for the most of their population
